verdict.rationale: Runpod's Pod docs list a 'web proxy for exposed web services' as a way to reach applications served from a Pod, so the port-exposure half of the story has first-party support. The evidence only says this in a single line, though. Private networking between instances is not documented directly: Instant Clusters mention 'high-performance networking' for multi-node jobs, which is cluster interconnect, not a general private network linking separate Pods. Community remarks that the environment is 'locked down' are about third-party tunneling tools and do not concretely contradict exposed services. Missing for 10: documentation of port configuration (HTTP/TCP ports, public IPs), an explicit private networking feature for connecting Pods, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can expose ports to serve applications from my instance and connect instances over private networking
